title: August and the Cellar
author: A. M. Whitlock
blurb: Oscar Kavanagh, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
